if (XRAY_USE_LUAJIT)
    add_subdirectory(LuaJIT-proj)
else()
    find_package(Lua51 REQUIRED)
endif()

add_library(sse2neon INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(sse2neon INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

set(ozz_build_tools         OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip offline command line tools" FORCE)
set(ozz_build_fbx           OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip FBX pipeline (no FBX SDK dependency)")
set(ozz_build_gltf          OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip glTF importer")
set(ozz_build_data          OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip data regeneration")
set(ozz_build_samples       OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip samples")
set(ozz_build_howtos        OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip howtos")
set(ozz_build_tests         OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: skip tests")
set(ozz_build_postfix       OFF CACHE BOOL "ozz: no per-config postfix")
set(ozz_build_msvc_rt_dll   ON  CACHE BOOL "ozz: use the DLL CRT like the rest of the engine")
set(_xray_prev_shared_libs ${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS})
set(_xray_prev_pic ${CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE})
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_subdirectory(ozz-animation EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${_xray_prev_shared_libs})
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ${_xray_prev_pic})
foreach(_ozz_tgt ozz_base ozz_animation ozz_animation_offline)
    target_compile_options(${_ozz_tgt} PRIVATE ${XRAY_DISABLE_WARNINGS})
endforeach()
if (PROJECT_PLATFORM_ARM OR PROJECT_PLATFORM_ARM64)
    target_compile_definitions(ozz_base PUBLIC "OZZ_SIMD_SSE4_1=")
    target_include_directories(ozz_base PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ozz-sse2neon")
    target_link_libraries(ozz_base PUBLIC sse2neon)
endif()

option(XRAY_USE_SYSTEM_SDL3 "Use an installed SDL3 (3.4 or newer) instead of building Externals/SDL" ON)
if (XRAY_USE_SYSTEM_SDL3)
    find_package(SDL3 3.4 CONFIG QUIET GLOBAL)
endif()
if (SDL3_FOUND)
    message(STATUS "SDL3: system ${SDL3_VERSION} (${SDL3_DIR})")
else()
    set(SDL_SHARED              OFF CACHE BOOL "Build SDL3 as static library")
    set(SDL_STATIC              ON  CACHE BOOL "Build SDL3 as static library")
    set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY        OFF CACHE BOOL "Skip SDL3 test library")
    set(SDL_INSTALL             OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable SDL3 install rules")
    set(SDL_DISABLE_INSTALL     ON  CACHE BOOL "Disable SDL3 install rules")
    set(SDL_DISABLE_INSTALL_DOCS ON CACHE BOOL "Disable SDL3 docs install")
    add_subdirectory(SDL)
    set_target_properties(SDL3-static PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    message(STATUS "SDL3: building Externals/SDL")
endif()

add_subdirectory(luabind)
add_subdirectory(xrLuaFix)
add_subdirectory(OPCODE)
add_subdirectory(ode)

set(NVRHI_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "Build NVRHI as static library")
if (WIN32)
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX11 ON CACHE BOOL "Enable D3D11 backend")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX12 ON CACHE BOOL "Enable D3D12 backend")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "Enable Vulkan backend")
else()
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX11 OFF CACHE BOOL "No D3D11 off-Windows")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_DX12 OFF CACHE BOOL "No D3D12 off-Windows")
    set(NVRHI_WITH_VULKAN ON CACHE BOOL "Enable Vulkan backend")
    if (APPLE)
        set(NVRHI_WITH_METAL3 ON CACHE BOOL "Enable native Metal 3 backend")
    endif()
endif()
set(NVRHI_WITH_VALIDATION ON CACHE BOOL "Enable validation layer for development")
set(NVRHI_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable NVRHI install rules")
set(NVRHI_WITH_RTXMU ON CACHE BOOL "Use RTXMU for BLAS suballocation and compaction on D3D12/Vulkan")
if (APPLE)
    set(MVK_CONFIG_LOG_LEVEL "warn" CACHE STRING "MoltenVK log level")
    set(MVK_EXCLUDE_SPIRV_TOOLS ON CACHE BOOL "MoltenVK: skip SPIRV-Tools (no debug disasm)")
    set(MVK_BUILD_SHADER_CONVERTER_TOOL OFF CACHE BOOL "MoltenVK: skip standalone shader converter tool")
    add_subdirectory(MoltenVK)
endif()

# Slang shader compiler
set(SLANG_ENABLE_CUDA OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable CUDA support")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_OPTIX OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable OptiX support")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_NVAPI OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable NVAPI support")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_XLIB OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable Xlib support")
if (WIN32 OR (APPLE AND NVRHI_WITH_METAL3))
    set(SLANG_ENABLE_DXIL ON CACHE BOOL "DXIL for D3D12 and the Metal shader converter")
else()
    set(SLANG_ENABLE_DXIL OFF CACHE BOOL "Vulkan-only platforms use SPIR-V")
endif()
set(SLANG_ENABLE_GFX OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable slang-gfx (we use NVRHI)")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_SLANGD OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable language server")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_SLANGC ON CACHE BOOL "Enable command line tool (needed to build the neural standard module)")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_SPLIT_DEBUG_INFO OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable slang split debug info (incompatible with XRay's output dir override)")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_SLANGI OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable interpreter")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_SLANGRT OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable runtime")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable Slang tests")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable Slang examples")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_SLANG_RHI OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable slang-rhi (only used by Slang tests and examples)")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_REPLAYER OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable slang-replay tool")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_SLANG_PROXY OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable slang.dll forwarding proxy (needs dumpbin)")
set(SLANG_ENABLE_PREBUILT_BINARIES OFF CACHE BOOL "Build from source")
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
add_subdirectory(slang)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${_xray_prev_shared_libs} CACHE BOOL "Build shared libraries" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${_xray_prev_shared_libs})
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ${_xray_prev_pic})
set_source_files_properties(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/slang/source/slang/slang-rich-diagnostics.cpp
    DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/slang/source/slang
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS
        "$<$<NOT:$<AND:$<CONFIG:Debug,Mixed>,$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>>>:$<IF:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>,/O1;/Os,$<IF:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:GNU>,-Os,-Oz>>>"
)

if(MSVC AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    foreach(spirv_target SPIRV-Tools-static SPIRV-Tools-shared SPIRV-Tools-opt SPIRV-Tools-link SPIRV-Tools-lint SPIRV-Tools-diff SPIRV-Tools-reduce)
        if(TARGET ${spirv_target})
            target_compile_options(${spirv_target} PRIVATE -Wno-error)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

if(APPLE AND NVRHI_WITH_METAL3)
    FetchContent_GetProperties(dxc_source SOURCE_DIR XRAY_DXC_SOURCE_DIR)
    if(XRAY_DXC_SOURCE_DIR)
        set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_INCLUDE_DIR "${XRAY_DXC_SOURCE_DIR}/include/dxc")
        set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_REFLECTION_INCLUDE_DIR "${XRAY_DXC_SOURCE_DIR}/external/DirectX-Headers/include/directx")
        set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_STUB_INCLUDE_DIR "${XRAY_DXC_SOURCE_DIR}/external/DirectX-Headers/include/wsl/stubs")
    endif()
    if(TARGET copy-dxcompiler)
        set(NVRHI_METAL_DXC_LIBRARY "${slang_BINARY_DIR}/$<CONFIG>/lib/libdxcompiler.dylib")
    endif()
endif()
add_subdirectory(nvrhi)
if(NOT NVRHI_BUILD_SHARED)
    foreach(nvrhi_backend nvrhi_vk nvrhi_d3d11 nvrhi_d3d12 nvrhi_metal3)
        if(TARGET ${nvrhi_backend})
            target_link_libraries(${nvrhi_backend} PUBLIC nvrhi)
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()
if (TARGET rtxmu AND NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(rtxmu PRIVATE "SHELL:-include string")
endif()

# Silence all warnings for external libraries
add_compile_options(${XRAY_DISABLE_WARNINGS})

add_subdirectory(GameSpy)
add_subdirectory(imgui-proj)
if (WIN32)
    add_subdirectory(DiscordGameSDK)
endif()

if (NOT TARGET xrLuabind)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "You probably have downloaded OpenXRay sources as ZIP archive, you can't do that. Use git to clone the repository.\n"
        "Read the build instructions: https://github.com/OpenXRay/xray-16/wiki"
    )
endif()
